hints.title: Examine Small Problem Bounds
hints.text: There are at most 10 bases and 10 toppings, making search space small enough for complete exploration.

hints.title: Branch on Topping Multipliers
hints.text: For each topping i, explore adding 0, 1, or 2 portions of its cost.

hints.title: Update Closest Cost
hints.text: Track cost with minimal absolute difference from target; break ties by picking the strictly smaller cost.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: B is number of base costs (<= 10)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded knapsack is unnecessary when topping quantities are restricted to 0, 1, or 2.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ternary recursive exploration explores 3^10 = 59,049 states per base in milliseconds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles tie-breaking by taking lower cost and prunes when current cost exceeds target.
